data.body:
FINALIZED SCOPE (operator-approved 2026-09-02) — supersedes the phase-boundary-only note above.

Keepalive granularity = BETWEEN LLM CALLS (agentic round-trips), coalesced by elapsed time.

WHAT TO EMIT:
- A keepalive line at LLM-call boundaries (the load-bearing case: an agentic phase with N model
  calls + tool use must not go silent for the whole phase; per-call bounds the worst-case silent
  gap to a single model round-trip, already transport-capped at 600s).
- Also at tool-call and phase boundaries, BUT coalesced: only actually emit if >= ~15-30s since the
  last keepalive line. A burst of fast tool calls collapses to nothing; a long call/tool triggers
  a line. This is ONE last-emit-timestamp comparison at the existing seam.
- Content: lightweight only — phase name + call index + elapsed seconds. NO prompt/response payload
  (avoids noise AND avoids leaking sensitive content).
- Via `logging` to stderr, at/above the DEFAULT effective level so it actually resets a supervisor
  stall watchdog (today's phase logs are INFO and sit below the default WARNING level -> useless;
  this must NOT repeat that). llm/** is not on the ruff T201 print allowlist, so `logging`, not print.

SEAMS (from RCA): llm/runner.py:296 (per LLM call, primary), llm/agent_call.py:178,202 (per tool
call), llm/workflow/executor.py:641 (per workflow step).

EXPLICITLY OUT (rejected as over-engineering): no background daemon-thread timer; no progress-gating
/ stall-escalation / health-withdrawal; no total-runtime cap. Emission is synchronous + main-thread,
therefore progress-linked BY CONSTRUCTION and cannot mask a hang.

CADENCE DRIVER: "no silent inter-emission gap approaches the 600s budget," not "emit as often as
possible."

RESIDUAL (accepted, backstopped): a single phase/call legitimately exceeding the budget is silent
for its duration -> backstopped by the per-request read timeout httpx.Timeout(cfg.timeout_s) default
600s (structured_run.py:419-427; anthropic_model.py:122 "never unbounded") + the AC-2 doc warning.

AC-2 (re-scoped): NOT a duration benchmark (docs decline one, plan-review-gate.md:1420-1424).
Instead a doc WARNING that gate ops routinely exceed common 600s supervisor stall budgets while
silent between calls, and how to raise those budgets; note DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S=600 is per-request and
the close path can issue many (close_autoresume while-loop up to verify.auto_resume_max).

LIFECYCLE: retype bug -> task. ACs: (1) a gate invocation that takes minutes emits >=1 keepalive
line well inside a 600s window, driven by real per-call progress; (2) bursts of rapid tool calls do
NOT produce a line per call (coalesced); (3) the doc warning lands; (4) silence-tolerance tests
test_no_total_runtime_timer_mechanism + test_slow_but_alive_server_completes_under_read_timeout stay
GREEN (purely additive; no total-runtime cap).
